transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time for this pre-purchase review of the indoor-air-quality monitoring system for the science wing. As you know, the vendor offers a six-monitor package at $3,100 and a nine-monitor package at $4,320. Our preliminary discussions have focused on the six-monitor package, but before I give final approval, I'd like to go through our standard review process. We need to cover three areas: a facilities check, a funding review, and a health review. So let's hear from each of you on your respective areas. Who would like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I should start with the facilities check. I completed my inspection of the science wing this week, and I found that there are nine separate classrooms that each need a monitor because they all have separate ventilation zones. The room-by-room report hasn't been entered into the purchasing worksheet yet, but the bottom line is that all nine rooms require their own monitor.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I can address the funding review. I verified the ledger this week, and I confirmed that a restricted capital account has exactly enough approved funding to cover the $4,320 nine-monitor package. No general-fund transfer would be needed. The formal finance memo is still awaiting completion of this pre-purchase review, but the funds are there and available.
transcript.speaker: A3
